component.name: Wayfrost
component.summary: Screen text extractor for Wayland (Live Text / PowerToys-style)

description.p: Wayfrost captures a region of your screen and returns the extracted text to your clipboard. It works on GNOME, Hyprland, KDE, and other Wayland compositors through XDG Desktop Portal, optional Wayland-native tools (grim), or a companion GNOME Shell extension for silent instant capture.

ul.li: Full Turkish and English OCR (ç, ğ, ı, ö, ş, ü supported)
Two backends: Tesseract (bundled) and PP-OCR ONNX model
2D spatial line clustering for correct reading order
Keyboard-first selection, click-drag a region, text lands in clipboard
